issue.title: Finish shell completion — correct results, bash insertion, and an honest lifecycle
issue.description: Every shell-completion reply means what bob itself would do with it, bash inserts exactly what bob returned, and `bob completion` / `just install` probe quickly from a real terminal and report registration, exit codes, and closers honestly — so epic bob-cli-3j can land.

issue.title: Honest, fast bob completion lifecycle
issue.description: lifecycle: run shell probes in their own session so they never stall under a terminal, stop status from probing or failing not-installed shells, honor $SHELL alongside owned adapters, align glyphs, exit codes, and closers with registration, keep stale compdumps visible, refuse unrecorded stamped files, and add the lifecycle tests the original plan required.
